programme.desc: The Rev. Shay moves out West to set up his new home in Montana so that he can spread God's word. But when his wife, Raysha, leaves him for another man -- in part because she wants to return to Philadelphia -- the reverend decides to replace his spiritual ways with a gun. After shooting down his wife and her lover, he battles a landowner intent on keeping all the town's water for himself. But his deadly ways make him yearn for a belief in God again.

programme.title: Quick Pitch
programme.desc: Sometimes, fans of America's national pastime might miss a day or two of their favorite sport due to pesky things like work, a wedding anniversary, or a child's high-school graduation ceremony. Rest easy, devotees of the diamond -- MLB Network has you covered. "Quick Pitch" not only provides complete highlights of each game from the previous day, but also presents a glimpse at upcoming contests, including pitching matchups.

programme.title: Play Ball
programme.desc: Major League Baseball's initiative to promote the game to a younger generation includes "Play Ball," a half-hour series that features some of the game's top players. The players discuss their own experiences in youth baseball and various ways in which they enjoyed the game while growing up. The show also provides tips on how kids can participate in all forms of baseball activities, plus highlights on and off the field throughout MLB.

programme.title: MLB Network Breakdown
programme.desc: The best breakdowns and demos by MLB Network Analysts will be showcased including segments from the 9,600-square foot Studio 42 and on-screen virtual enhancements that are integral to MLB Network's comprehensive coverage of the game.

programme.title: Live: MLB Tonight
programme.desc: When they're not tuning in to the games themselves, baseball fans know where to turn for their nightly baseball fix. MLB Network's signature program, "MLB Tonight" presents complete coverage of all of the games, beginning with the first pitch on the East Coast and ending with the final out on the West Coast. The Emmy-winning studio show features highlights, live look-ins and breaking news, plus analysis from a rotating roster that includes former players Eric Byrnes, Al Leiter, Dan Plesac, Billy Ripken and Mike Lowell, and inside information men Tom Verducci, Jon Heyman, Peter Gammons and Ken Rosenthal. Greg Amsinger, Brian Kenny and Matt Vasgersian are among the hosts.

programme.title: Live: MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown.".

programme.title: Live: MLB Now
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls.

programme.title: Live: Intentional Talk
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media.

programme.title: Oklahoma Annie
programme.desc: Judy Canova (Judy Canova) is a capable cowgirl and a sassy shopkeeper in her frontier town. But, once she spies the dashing new town sheriff, Dan Fraser (John Russell), Judy decides to branch out into catching crooks to garner his notice. With her daring behavior and bravery, she soon earns a deputy's badge, allowing her to spend time with her favorite lawman. But, when Dan is abducted by a band of wild outlaws, it's up to Judy to round up a posse and save the day.

programme.title: Border Badmen
programme.desc: After the death of a rich and very distant cousin, bumbling cowboy Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) convinces his pal Billy (Buster Crabbe) to travel with him to the dead man's estate to try to claim the fortune. When they arrive, they meet Helen Stockton (Lorraine Miller), the rightful heir to the estate, but the cousin's scheming superintendent wants the inheritance for himself, so he sends his henchmen after Fuzzy, Billy and Helen. The trio must thwart the crooks and vie for the money.

programme.title: Kill Johnny Ringo
programme.desc: Mysterious drifter Johnny Ringo arrives in a small town to put an end to a ruthless counterfeiting gang, facing danger and deception along the way.

programme.title: 'Neath the Arizona Skies
programme.desc: A cowboy escorts a young half-Native American girl, whose mother has recently died. He must find her white father in order to claim her hefty inheritance.

programme.title: Panhandle
programme.desc: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

programme.title: Treasure of Ruby Hills
programme.desc: Cattlemen Reynolds (Barton MacLane) and Payne (Charles Fredericks) use their influence to edge less powerful ranchers out of the bountiful Ruby Hills Valley, then set their sights on eliminating each another. While they're busy fighting over the land, the peace-minded Ross Haney (Zachary Scott) buys up all the water rights to the valley. But Haney's bid for order is disrupted by Doran (Dick Foran), a scheming third rancher, who supplies the warring parties with deadly gunfighters.

programme.title: Oklahoma Annie
programme.desc: Judy Canova (Judy Canova) is a capable cowgirl and a sassy shopkeeper in her frontier town. But, once she spies the dashing new town sheriff, Dan Fraser (John Russell), Judy decides to branch out into catching crooks to garner his notice. With her daring behavior and bravery, she soon earns a deputy's badge, allowing her to spend time with her favorite lawman. But, when Dan is abducted by a band of wild outlaws, it's up to Judy to round up a posse and save the day.

programme.title: Susanna Pass
programme.desc: After finding a large oil bed underneath a lake, crooked engineer Del Roberts (Douglas Fowley) plots to take control of a fish hatchery run by Russell Masters (Lucien Littlefield), brother of Roberts' accomplice, Martin Masters (Robert Emmett Keane). Acting sheriff Roy (Roy Rogers) and his deputies square off against Roberts and his henchmen, and visiting female ichthyologist "Doc" Parker (Dale Evans) is caught in the crossfire between the opposing camps.

programme.title: Little Big Horn
programme.desc: Captain Phillip Donlin (Lloyd Bridges) and his small troop must rush to reach Little Big Horn in order to warn General Custer of the Sioux attack that awaits him. As they race against time, and Donlin pushes them hard through an arduous and dangerous journey, the Sioux start taking out the soldiers one at a time. Meanwhile, Donlin also clashes with Lt. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor).

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
programme.desc: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor.

programme.title: Brother Outlaw
programme.desc: A man is framed for bank robbery, prompting his brother to spring him from jail. Their search for the real culprits ends in a violent confrontation with a famed gunfighter.

programme.title: Sitting Bull
programme.desc: Recognizing that Maj. Robert Parrish (Dale Robertson) has a history of making peace with Native American tribes, President Ulysses S. Grant (John Hamilton) sends him to iron out a land dispute with Chief Sitting Bull (J. Carrol Naish). Though negotiations seem to be going well, Parrish can't stop the deadly Battle of Little Big Horn. Many die, but when he helps Sitting Bull survive, Parrish is charged with crimes against the government, and he will be executed unless Grant steps in.

programme.title: McLintock!
programme.desc: Aging rancher George Washington McLintock, a wealthy self-made man, is forced to deal with numerous personal and professional problems. Seemingly everyone wants a piece of his enormous farmstead, including high-ranking government men, McLintock's own sons and nearby Native Americans. As McLintock tries to juggle his various adversaries, his wife, who left him two years previously, suddenly returns. But she isn't interested in her husband -- she wants custody of their daughter.

programme.title: John Wayne Behind-the-Scenes: Filming of Stunts, Chases, Fights, Crashes & Gun Battles
programme.desc: Rare production features, TV clips, and special promos provide a behind-the-scenes look at the stunts, fights, gun battles and chases from John Wayne movies including "Stagecoach," "War Wagon," "Brannigan" and "McLintock.".

programme.title: The Unforgiven
programme.desc: The Zachary family live quietly on a cattle ranch in post-Civil War Texas. A stranger (Joseph Wiseman) appears and disturbs their bucolic existence by spreading a malicious rumor that their adopted daughter, Rachel (Audrey Hepburn), is a Kiowa Native American. Soon, the Zachary brothers (Audie Murphy, Burt Lancaster) and their mother (Lillian Gish) must defend themselves from both racist whites and vengeful Kiowa.

programme.title: Jericho
programme.desc: Jericho (Mark Valley) wakes up with no memory, but it's apparent that he's quite skilled with a gun. He is befriended by Joshua (Leon Coffee), who appears to be his polar opposite: He's a black man and true believer in the Lord, whereas Jericho is white and doubtful of everything, especially himself. Side by side, they attempt to piece together the amnesiac's past, which may or may not have something to do with a robbery, and either way is somehow connected to a town that's also called Jericho.

programme.title: Killing Streets
programme.desc: When he's informed that his twin brother has died in Beirut, basketball coach Craig Brandt (Michael Paré) flies to Lebanon to investigate for himself. His brother was a U.S. Marine who, according to the military, died in an explosion during an anti-terrorist operation. At the U.S. Embassy, Craig meets with Charles Wolf (Lorenzo Lamas), who backs up the official story. programme.title: The One That Got Away
programme.desc: Franz von Werra (Hardy Kruger) is a Luftwaffe pilot by trade, but an escape artist by necessity. When his plane is attacked over England, he initiates his first effort to break out of the POW camp only days after arriving. Transferred to a second, more secure facility, Franz nevertheless manages to tunnel out and very nearly steals an airplane before being recaptured. This time the Allies send him to be imprisoned in Canada, but he steadfastly insists that no cell will hold him.

programme.title: The Big Knife
programme.desc: Movie star Charles Castle draws the ire of Hollywood producer Stanley Hoff when he refuses to sign a new seven-year contract. Castle is sick of the low quality of the studio's films and wants to start a new life. While his estranged wife supports him in the decision, Castle's talent agent urges him to reconsider. When Castle continues to be uncooperative, Hoff resorts to blackmail in order to get his way.

programme.title: The Comedy of Terrors
programme.desc: Waldo Trumbull (Vincent Price) is an amoral undertaker in 19th-century New England who takes to murdering people to have enough cash to support his drinking habit. Desperate for money after a widow stiffs him for a burial, Trumbull and his assistant, Gillie (Peter Lorre), decide to kill the wealthy Mr. Black (Basil Rathbone), their landlord, to whom they're indebted. But murdering Black proves to be quite a challenge, as he seems to keep recovering from death every time they do him in.

programme.title: Sleepaway Camp 2: Unhappy Campers
programme.desc: Angela Baker (Pamela Springsteen), a psychotic transsexual, escapes from a mental hospital and surfaces at a summer camp as a counselor who lectures her teenage charges on proper moral behavior. Those teens who break her strict rules -- from the camp chatterbox or a sex-obsessed girl to the boys who are peeping Toms -- are murdered by the impostor in various gruesome ways. As more campers go missing, intrepid counselor Molly (Renee Estevez) begins to piece together the truth.

programme.title: Sleepaway Camp 3: Teenage Wasteland
programme.desc: Psychotic Angela (Pamela Springsteen) is itching to do what she does best: slaughter dozens of teenage campers. As luck would have it, the previous site of her murders has been renamed and converted into an experimental summer camp meant to bring together privileged and lower-class teens. On the day the youths are boarding the buses to camp, Angela runs over a potential camper with a garbage truck and assumes her identity. Once she has infiltrated the camp, the real terror begins.

programme.title: Dr. Heckyl and Mr. Hype
programme.desc: The kind but physically disfigured Dr. Heckyl is so distraught over his continual failures with the opposite sex that he decides to end his life by overdosing on an extra-strength diet drink. Strangely, he doesn't die -- he transforms into slick stud Mr. Hype. Unfortunately, Hype has an insatiable thirst for blood, and he ends up killing his dates before any romance unfolds. He soon sets his sights on the sweet Coral, who secretly loves Heckyl, but not Hype.

programme.title: The Lost Empire
programme.desc: Long-legged women warriors dress lightly on the island of evil Dr. Sin Do, also known as Li Chuk.

programme.title: Vampires on Bikini Beach
programme.desc: Californians (Jennifer Badham, Todd Kaufman) try to save their beach from a ghoul and his gang.

programme.title: X: The Man With the X-Ray Eyes
programme.desc: Intent on enhancing mankind's ocular ability, the brilliant Dr. James Xavier (Ray Milland) invents a formula that allows him to see wavelengths of light outside the normal human spectrum. When his funding is suddenly threatened, Xavier tests the formula on himself despite the protests of his colleague Dr. Diane Fairfax (Diana Van der Vlis). While the formula proves initially useful in a variety of minor tasks, Xavier soon finds himself able to see things that no man was meant to see.

programme.title: Revenge of the Zombies
programme.desc: Scott Warrington (Mauritz Hugo) returns to his childhood home in Louisiana after learning that his deceased sister, Lila (Veda Ann Borg), may have been poisoned. He brings a detective (Robert Lowery) with him, and they switch identities to protect Scott. At first, they find only Lila's sad husband, Dr. von Altermann (John Carradine). Secretly, however, von Altermann is a Nazi who has been perfecting a way to turn the dead, including Lila, into an army of zombies who will serve Hitler.

programme.title: Fanfare for a Death Scene
programme.desc: A federal agent (Richard Egan) tries to find a missing physicist who keeps a top-secret formula in his head.

programme.title: No Such Thing
programme.desc: Disgusted with human evolution, a foul-mouthed monster kills anyone who crosses his path. When a news crew sent to investigate the monster disappears, a guileless young woman is dispatched to follow up on the story. She befriends the monster and becomes his only hope in ending his life of misery.

programme.title: Tower of London
programme.desc: In 15th-century England, Richard III (Vincent Price) desperately wants the throne, but his ailing brother, King Edward IV (Justice Watson), instead bestows it upon his other sibling, Clarence (Richard McCauly). This sends Richard into a homicidal rage, resulting in Clarence's murder and the deaths and torture of many others who could keep the crown from the crazed man. But as the mayhem continues, Richard's sanity slips, and the ghosts of the murdered men begin to haunt the beleaguered royal.

programme.title: The Pit and the Pendulum
programme.desc: Elizabeth Barnard Medina (Barbara Steele) has died in the prime of life, and her brother, Francis (John Kerr), wants to know why. Elizabeth's husband, Nicholas (Vincent Price), and her doctor offer differing explanations, but when Francis learns that Nicholas' mother may have been buried alive, he begins to wonder if his sister met the same fate. And when he comes to believe that Elizabeth's spirit wanders about Nicholas' castle, Francis investigates -- and is stunned by what he finds.

Rollins Jr.) rose from being an insurance agent to become one of the most integral activists of the era. From boycotting white merchants in the mid '50s to being a key figure in desegregating the University of Mississippi in 1962, Evers met success, and with it many enemies. When racists swarm his house, his life and the lives of his wife (Irene Cara) and children are threatened.

programme.title: Getting Even
programme.desc: Rival Texas chemical magnates (Edward Albert, Joe Don Baker) hold Dallas hostage over nerve gas stolen from the Soviets.

programme.title: Mercenary Fighters
programme.desc: An emerging African nation pits soldiers of fortune (Peter Fonda, Reb Brown, Ron O'Neal) against rebels blocking a dam project.

programme.title: Windprints
programme.desc: Young South African cameraman Anton van Heerden and aging British journalist Charles Rutherford team up to gather information about an apparent Namibian serial killer. In a country ruled by a minority white government, Nhadiep seems only to murder other blacks. His proximity to the strange and horrifying crimes causes Anton to contemplate his role as a privileged white man in a continent where millions of blacks are oppressed.

programme.title: Mandela
programme.desc: This documentary follows the beloved South African leader Nelson Mandela from his early days to his presidency, depicting South Africa and its turbulent years during apartheid control, which was brought to an end in 1994 with the nation's democratic election of Mandela as president. Focus is placed on Mandela's early education, his personal relationships, and his political activism for the African National Congress, which led to his 27-year imprisonment for sabotage.

programme.title: Blacula
programme.desc: During a visit to Transylvania, an African prince (William Marshall) gets turned into a vampire by Count Dracula (Charles Macaulay). Sealed in a coffin for several lifetimes, "Blacula" reawakens in the 1970s Los Angeles. Leaving a trail of bloodless victims in his wake, he pursues Lina (Vonetta McGee), a woman who bears a striking resemblance to his dead wife. Meanwhile, Dr. Gordon Thomas (Thalmus Rasulala) and top cop Lt. Peters (Gordon Pinsent) are hot on the bloodsucker's trail.

programme.title: Scream Blacula Scream
programme.desc: When a hated rival, Lisa Fortier (Pam Grier), is chosen to lead the voodoo cult of Willis Daniels' (Richard Lawson) late mother, a vengeful Willis brings the doomed vampire Prince Mamuwalde (William Marshall) back to life. Willis soon finds the vampire too powerful to control, and Lisa agrees to perform a spell that will break the curse placed on the prince. But, when racist sheriff Dunlop (Michael Conrad) gets involved, the vampire unleashes his deadly revenge.

programme.title: J.D.'s Revenge
programme.desc: Although notorious New Orleans gangster J.D. Walker (David McKnight) is shot and killed in the 1940s, his spirit remains restless for three decades, until a hypnotist's supernatural nightclub act allows him to take over the body of Isaac (Glynn Turman), a mild-mannered law student. After inhabiting Isaac, Walker decides to hunt down the Rev. Elija Bliss (Louis Gossett Jr.), a former criminal who helped the authorities find and assassinate the mobster years ago.

programme.title: Sugar Hill
programme.desc: When nightclub owner Langston (Larry D. Johnson) refuses to sell out to local mob boss Morgan (Robert Quarry), he is beaten to death by a gang of hired thugs. His grief-stricken fiancée, Diana "Sugar" Hill (Marki Bey), vows revenge for his murder and turns to aged voodoo authority Mama Maitresse (Zara Cully). Together they conjure up the demonic spirit of Baron Samedi (Don Pedro Colley), who agrees to help Sugar. He raises an army of zombies and sets them upon Langston's killers.

programme.title: Cooley High
programme.desc: Richard "Cochise" Morris (Lawrence-Hilton Jacobs), a local basketball hero, and Leroy "Preach" Jackson (Glynn Turman), who dreams of a career in writing, are likable Chicago high school students in Chicago in the 1960s. They're into hanging out with friends, pretty girls and the Motown sounds so popular during the era. Each wants to make it big in his own way, but not everybody they meet is looking out for them, as they learn when a seemingly harmless outing goes awry.

programme.title: Breakin' 2: Electric Boogaloo
programme.desc: Disappointed with her small part in the chorus line of a Los Angeles show, jazz dancer Kelly (Lucinda Dickey) quits and heads home. Her father (John Christy Ewing) disapproves of Kelly's friendship with street dancers Ozone (Adolfo "Shabba-Doo" Quinones) and Turbo (Michael "Boogaloo Shrimp" Chambers), and encourages her to pursue an opportunity to perform in Paris. Ignoring his wishes, Kelly teams up with her friends for a break-dancing benefit show to save an endangered community center.

programme.title: Rappin'
programme.desc: An ex-convict (Mario Van Peebles) shows residents of his Pittsburgh ghetto how to drive out riffraff with rap music.

programme.title: Beat Street
programme.desc: At the forefront of early hip-hop culture, DJ Kenny Kirkland (Guy Davis), his B-boy brother, Lee (Robert Taylor), and graffiti artist Ramon (John Chardiet) all have hopes of showcasing their talents outside the confines of South Bronx, N.Y. When Tracy Carlson (Rae Dawn Chong), a composer and choreographer, runs into Kirkland and Lee at one of Manhattan's hottest nightclubs, she offers Lee an opportunity to perform on TV. However, the crew has a long way to go before achieving their dreams.

programme.title: Hurricane Streets
programme.desc: A stark portrait of kids living on the edge, "Hurricane Streets" focuses on one teenager's fight to change the circumstances of his life. Brendan Sexton III delivers a powerful performance in the central role of Marcus, a street-smart teen who dreams of the day that he can escape the city trap and live with his mother in the wide open spaces of New Mexico.

programme.title: Crack House
programme.desc: Rick (Gregg Thomsen) and Melissa (Cheryl Kay) are two young lovebirds struggling against the crime and poverty of the Los Angeles ghetto they inhabit. Their hopes of ever leaving are destroyed when one of Rick's relatives is killed in a drive-by shooting. Seeking to avenge the vicious murder, Rick rejoins his former gang, but gets himself arrested. During his absence, Melissa becomes involved with drug dealers and is addicted to crack. Rick then sets out on a difficult mission to save her.

programme.title: Original Gangstas
programme.desc: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence.

programme.title: Slaughter
programme.desc: After his parents are killed by a car bomb, a former Green Beret named Slaughter (Jim Brown) begins investigating and is shocked to discover they were targets of a Mafia hit. He decides to settle the score on his own and successfully takes out some of the gangsters responsible before being caught by police. Now faced with a murder charge, Slaughter strikes a deal with government officials to have the charges dropped provided he can find and kill another gangster who's since fled to Mexico.

programme.title: I Escaped From Devil's Island
programme.desc: A convicted murderer leads a band of men through shark-infested waters in an attempt to escape the fortress prison.

programme.title: Fort Defiance
programme.desc: After the Civil War, veteran Ben Shelby (Ben Johnson) travels to Arizona to seek out fellow veteran Johnny Tallon (Dane Clark). After saving Johnny's blind brother, Ned (Peter Graves), from being trampled by a horse, Ben accompanies him to the family ranch. While Ben and Ned become friends, Ned's uncle grows suspicious about Ben's claim of friendship with Johnny. As they all wait for news of Johnny, they face an Indian attack and the arrival of vengeful former soldiers also seeking Johnny.

programme.title: The Mercenary
programme.desc: Sergei Kowalski, a mercenary only out for himself and a few dollars, joins up with a Mexican peasant-turned-revolutionary, Paco Roman, when the price is right. No longer content to toil for the rich and powerful, Roman plans to bring a new order to Mexico by force with his small ragtag group. While Roman and Kowalski are outnumbered facing the Mexican army, they also have to contend with Curly, a vengeful killer out for blood.

programme.title: The Dalton Girls
programme.desc: After the criminal Dalton brothers are slain, two of the brothers' eldest daughters, Holly and Rose, get into an altercation with an undertaker and are forced to kill him. On the run from Detective Hiram Parsh, who pursued the Dalton brothers for years, Holly and Rose take assumed names and begin a life of petty crime in order to get money to send their younger sisters, Columbine and Marigold, to school in the East.

programme.title: The Broken Star
programme.desc: Deputy Marshal Frank Smeed (Howard Duff) guns down an innocent Mexican who was about to deliver a huge sum of gold to a land tycoon, then makes off with the loot and covers his tracks by claiming that the man he shot was a dangerous criminal. Deputy Marshal Bill Gantry (Bill Williams) is charged with investigating the matter to ensure that his close friend Smeed was in the right. When he gets too close to discovering the truth, the crooked deputy tries to make Gantry his next victim.

programme.title: Bat Masterson
programme.desc: The U.S. Army recruits Bat after several enraged Indian tribes accuse white men of abducting their women and children; Bat must find the culprits before a war breaks out.

programme.title: Bat Masterson

programme.title: Tombstone Territory
programme.desc: Hollister spots a known criminal whose sidekick is sure to be joining him, and tries to lay a trap for the slippery crooks.

programme.title: Tombstone Territory
programme.desc: Hollister investigates when thousands of dollars of payroll money is stolen, but the Army suspects the courier made off with the cash.

programme.title: The Brass Legend
programme.desc: Sheriff Wade Addams is engaged to Linda Gipson and searching for an elusive killer, Tris Hatten. programme.title: Gunslinger
programme.desc: When her marshal husband is murdered, Rose Hood (Beverly Garland) slides on his holster and takes his dangerous duty. This riles local brothel madam Erica Page (Allison Hayes), so she employs Cane Miro (John Ireland), a hired gun with an axe to grind, to bring an end to Hood and her brand of justice. When Miro meets Hood, though, he is struck by her strength and beauty. Still, the passion that begins to burn between them will not prevent their inevitable showdown.

programme.title: Sitting Bull
programme.desc: Recognizing that Maj. Robert Parrish (Dale Robertson) has a history of making peace with Native American tribes, President Ulysses S. Though negotiations seem to be going well, Parrish can't stop the deadly Battle of Little Big Horn. Many die, but when he helps Sitting Bull survive, Parrish is charged with crimes against the government, and he will be executed unless Grant steps in.

programme.title: Southwest Passage

When one of Beale's men discovers McDonald's fraud, he blackmails the thief for a share of the bank loot. But then a far more menacing threat emerges in the form of American Indian warriors.

programme.title: Cannon for Cordoba
programme.desc: During the 1912 Mexican Revolution, rebel leader Hector Córdoba (Raf Vallone) and his bloodthirsty revolutionaries slip across the Texas border and liberate a number of cannons from a U.S. Army fort. programme.title: God Forgives, I Don't
programme.desc: Psychotic bandit Bill San Antonio kills all the passengers on a train and steals a fortune in gold. Hutch Bessy, an insurance investigator, and his gunslinger partner, Cat Stevens, go on the hunt for Bill, hoping to retrieve the loot. Unfortunately, outlaws take Hutch and Cat prisoner. Cat manages to get away and saves Hutch's life. When Cat is kidnapped later by other crooks, Hutch has to reciprocate. But they still have Bill to worry about.

programme.title: Comanche
programme.desc: Renegade Comanche leader Black Cloud (Henry Brandon) attacks a Mexican village and kidnaps the beautiful Margarita Alvarez (Linda Cristal). Fleeing to the United States, they come across a band of scalp hunters and are prevented from massacring them by the Comanche chief of the Antelope tribe, Quanah (Kent Smith). Despite the efforts of frontier scout Jim Read (Dana Andrews), turmoil erupts between the whites and the rebel Comanche, and Quanah and Read struggle to restore peace.

programme.title: Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: In this 19th-century drama, an American family from the Northeast heads to Wyoming in search of a better life, only to face tragedy and hardship. Maggie Sergent (Joanna Pettet), the hard-driving matriarch of the clan, is totally unprepared when her husband, John (William Shatner), is murdered. Left to handle the farm on her own, Maggie must choose whether to stay in Wyoming and run the farm with her children, or head back to the East Coast and the life she knows.

programme.title: From Noon Till Three
programme.desc: Bank robber Graham Dorsey spends a few hours with beautiful widow Amanda Starbuck, in which time his gang takes part in a disastrous holdup. Learning of his comrades' demise, Dorsey goes on the lam. Believing her short-term lover was killed by the law, Amanda decides to make the most of having had a liaison with the supposedly deceased desperado by writing a book about him. Much to his confusion, the still-living Dorsey watches as his name becomes legendary.

programme.title: The Hunting Party
programme.desc: Brandt Ruger (Gene Hackman) is a rich cattle rancher. He has a bad relationship with his wife, Melissa (Candice Bergen), whom he treats like a possession. While Brandt is away from home on a hunting trip, Frank Calder (Oliver Reed), a brazen outlaw, kidnaps Melissa and holds her for ransom. Frank, however, treats Melissa better than her own husband does, and before long she begins to develop feelings for him. When Brandt returns, he's enraged and vows to take violent revenge against Frank.

programme.title: Barquero
programme.desc: Jake Remy (Warren Oates) and his band of mercenaries shoot their way through a tiny border town, planning to escape with their plunder across the river into Mexico. They dispatch a few men to neutralize the local ferryman, Travis (Lee Van Cleef), but he and flinty mountain man Phil (Forrest Tucker) foil the scheme. By the time Jake reaches the river, Travis has already taken everyone from the town to the Mexican side. He refuses passage to the mercenaries, and a lengthy standoff ensues.

programme.desc: Cavalry veteran Sgt. Wade McCoy immediately butts heads with his new supervisor, Lt. Jonathan Davenport, over the latter's lack of experience on the treacherous route known as the "Tomahawk Trail," but Davenport's unfamiliarity with the territory proves deadly when a trip to Fort Bowie finds the troop under Apache attack. programme.title: Captain John Smith and Pocahontas
programme.desc: Back in England after his trip to Jamestown, Va., Capt. John Smith (Anthony Dexter) tells the tale of his journey, particularly his lost romance with Native American maiden Pocahontas (Jody Lawrence). They meet and gradually fall for each other when captured Smith is saved from certain death by the girl. But as Smith tries to maintain peace between the British colonists and local tribes, the task proves harrowing, and Smith's friend Rolfe (Robert Clarke) begins to move in on Pocahontas.

programme.title: Grayeagle
programme.desc: One day while reputable trapper John Colter (Ben Johnson) is away from home, his adoring daughter Beth (Lana Wood) is captured by the notorious Indian Grayeagle (Alex Cord). But, as her father begins his tireless search to recover her, Beth is surprised to discover that there is more to Grayeagle than his fearsome reputation would imply. As she grows to realize that he is a man of honor -- much like her father -- she begins to fall in love with this proud Cheyenne warrior.

programme.title: The Yellow Tomahawk
programme.desc: After commanding the brutal slaughter of a Cheyenne tribe, callous cavalry leader Maj. Ives (Warner Anderson) then orders the construction of a military base on Native American territory. While the surviving Cheyenne men plot their revenge, warrior Fireknife (Lee Van Cleef) contacts his friend cavalry scout Adam Reed (Rory Calhoun), and warns him of the bloodbath that will occur if Ives doesn't retreat from the area. Reed passes on the message, which falls on deaf ears, and chaos ensues.

programme.title: The Iroquois Trail

programme.title: War Drums
programme.desc: Mangas Coloradas (Lex Barker), an Apache chief, and white trader Luke Fargo (Ben Johnson) are bound by friendship and their mutual love for Riva (Joan Taylor), a Mexican-Native American girl rescued from horse thieves. Riva marries Mangas, who teaches her the warrior's ways, and she later warns the Apaches of an ambush by white soldiers. When Fargo, who did not intend an attack, is injured, Riva helps him -- a kindness he must choose whether or not to return when war with the Apaches erupts.

This motley crew's path is difficult, and they face many obstacles, not the least of which is nasty frontiersman Stan Bodine (Walter Matthau).

programme.title: Mon guide yoga

programme.title: L'architecture des possibles
programme.desc: De l'appartement salvateur de Katia Daraîche à un parc inclusif arraché à la bureaucratie, nous explorons des lieux où l'accessibilité devient une urgence concrète. Le quotidien en fauteuil ou avec une déficience visuelle est analysé avec précision, entre stationnements inadaptés, logements introuvables, trottoirs hostiles et solutions créatives. L'art y trouve aussi sa place, grâce à une salle de spectacle qui traduit la danse en gestes et en mots.

programme.title: Et si c'était toi?

programme.title: Voir la musique autrement
programme.desc: Si le chanteur belge Frédéric Lamory chante l'amour avec sincérité et que l'organiste français Jean d'Alby peut veiller sans heurts sur l'instrument patrimonial qui lui est confié, c'est grâce au support constant de deux femmes d'exception.

programme.title: Style sur mesure
programme.desc: Avec son amputation transtibiale, Mélanie souhaite trouver un style éclatant et élégant qui souligne sa féminité. Elle donne carte blanche à l'équipe d'experts pour refléter sa personnalité pétillante. Le résultat est flamboyant.

programme.title: Zombie Cars: sauvés de la scrap
programme.desc: Ce n'est qu'en 1976 que la Renault 5 arrive de ce côté-ci de l'Atlantique, mais entre elle et le Québec, c'est le coup de foudre. La province devient l'un des rares marchés où les ventes de celle-ci dépassent même celles de la Honda Civic. Les publicités du véhicule misent sur des vedettes locales, dont Robert Charlebois, Michel Côté et Ghyslain Tremblay. Puis, on crée l'engouement autour de la Renault 5 en comparant le sentiment qu'on a à la conduire à une maladie qui s'attrape: le Chnac!

programme.title: Transmission impossible

programme.title: Transmission impossible
programme.desc: Les frères Gosselin entament la reproduction de la mythique "funny car" ayant appartenu au champion dragster Joe Amato.

programme.title: Transmission impossible

programme.title: Chasseurs de voitures
programme.desc: L'équipe lutte contre les éléments alors que des inondations massives menacent de détruire les trésors automobiles laissés par des générations de pêcheurs commerciaux.

programme.title: Camionneurs de brousse

programme.title: Les Pierrafeu
programme.desc: Les Pierrafeu étaient la famille moderne de l'âge de la Pierre. Résidant dans la ville Saint-Granit, Fred Caillou n'était pas satisfait de son travail à la carrière, mais revenait à la maison auprès de sa charmante épouse Wilma et, enfin de sa fille Agathe. Fred, un grand amateur de golf et de quilles aimait aussi taquiner son voisin Arthur Laroche, tandis que la femme coquine d'Arthur, Bertha était la meilleure amie de Wilma. Au cours de l'émission, Barney et Betty ont adopté un fils anormalement fort, Bamm-Bamm, qui allait devenir plus tard ami avec Agathe. Les Pierrafeu, fortement inspiré par "The Honeymooners" ont convaincu une génération d'enfants que dinosaures et humains ont occupé la planète en même temps.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Les Pierrafeu
programme.desc: Les Pierrafeu étaient la famille moderne de l'âge de la Pierre. Résidant dans la ville Saint-Granit, Fred Caillou n'était pas satisfait de son travail à la carrière, mais revenait à la maison auprès de sa charmante épouse Wilma et, enfin de sa fille Agathe. Fred, un grand amateur de golf et de quilles aimait aussi taquiner son voisin Arthur Laroche, tandis que la femme coquine d'Arthur, Bertha était la meilleure amie de Wilma. Au cours de l'émission, Barney et Betty ont adopté un fils anormalement fort, Bamm-Bamm, qui allait devenir plus tard ami avec Agathe. Les Pierrafeu, fortement inspiré par "The Honeymooners" ont convaincu une génération d'enfants que dinosaures et humains ont occupé la planète en même temps.

programme.title: Los Otros
programme.desc: Antes de que el mundo bautizara a España como el país del tiqui-taca, antes de que no importara ser bajito o los porteros supieran jugar con los pies, el fútbol español vivía otra realidad. Otros tiempos marcados por entradas salvajes, campos de barro, arbitrajes permisivos, dureza y violencia. Pero no necesariamente fueron tiempos peores. Los Otros se sumerge de lleno en una era desconocida para millones de aficionados y plena de historias y personajes increíbles que pertenecen a un fútbol español difícilmente reconocible a día de hoy.

programme.title: Canito. El ídolo rebelde
programme.desc: De origen humilde y vida atribulada José Cano 'Canito', fue un jugador singular con una biografía tormentosa. Canito es hijo de la Barcelona de los setenta, de la calle, del barrio, de la marginalidad. Coqueteó con la delincuencia, pero el fútbol lo rescató, por un tiempo. Jugó, entre otros equipos, en el Cádiz, Español, su gran amor, Barcelona, Betis, Zaragoza y fue internacional en una ocasión. Enorme jugador, estaba destinado a convertirse en uno de los grandes futbolistas de su época por su talento y su portentoso físico. Pero su carácter rebelde e indomable le impidió alcanzar la gloria.

programme.title: 90 años de LaLiga
programme.desc: Andoni Zubizarreta desarrolló su carrera profesional en el Deportivo Alavés, Athletic Club, FCBarcelona y Valencia. Representante de la gran escuela de porteros vascos es el futbolista con más partidos disputados en la historia de la Primera División. Llegó a jugar 622 encuentros y todos ellos como titular entre 1981 y 1988. Formó parte de la época dorada del denominado ¿Dream Team¿ de Johan Cruyff conquistando la primera Copa de Europa de la historia del club catalán. En 1994 y con su sexto título de campeón de liga, abandonó el conjunto barcelonista para jugar en el Valencia CF. Líder natural, sobrio, respetuoso y profesional, Andoni Zubizarreta ha sido uno de los mejores porteros del campeonato español y todavía es también el primero de la clasificación de minutos jugados.

programme.title: El fútbol según Raúl
programme.desc: En tiempos de confinamiento, Raúl, encerrado en su casa, echa la vista atrás para recordar todas aquellas historias que ha contado a lo largo de su trayecto profesional en las pantallas de Movistar +. Tras revisar fotos, vídeos y recuerdos, decide llamar a buena parte de aquellos protagonistas y amigos que ha ido conociendo en el camino para saber de su nueva realidad a causa del coronavirus. Un viaje de Wuhan a Soria, pasando por Chile o Japón en el cual Raúl, una vez levantado el confinamiento, muestra la cara más trágica del virus, descubre héroes anónimos y retrata el estado del fútbol profesional y amateur en una época sin fútbol.

programme.title: 90 años de LaLiga
programme.desc: Argentina es el país que más jugadores extranjeros ha aportado a LaLiga en sus 90 años de historia hasta convertirse en la otra inagotable cantera de nuestros clubes. La idiosincrasia y las específicas condiciones de los futbolistas argentinos han asegurado un alto rendimiento a través de los tiempos. Su profesionalidad y su talento mezclado con un gen ganador eran y es una garantía. Jorge Valdano es uno de sus mejores exponentes por su continuidad en el tiempo, pero no hay que olvidar que desde el otro lado del Atlántico llegó entre otros el mismísimo Diego Armando Maradona. Valdano llegó a LaLiga en 1975 para jugar en el Deportivo Alavés. Debutó en Primera con el Zaragoza pero fue en el Real Madrid donde completó su exitosa carrera. Triunfó como jugador y entrenador para completar el círculo como director deportivo.

programme.title: Informe Robinson
programme.desc: Ocurrió en Japón hace 20 años. El 7 de marzo de 1999 era domingo y, por el cambio de hora, al despertar nos encontramos con una noticia excepcional. Un chico de Avilés, casi desconocido, había pulverizado una marca de una disciplina con poca tradición en España. Pasa el tiempo, pero un salto y un nombre permanecen imborrables en la historia del deporte español. 8'56m. Yago Lamela.

programme.title: Resumen Copa del Rey: 29/10/2026
programme.desc: No te pierdas los mejores momentos de la Copa del Rey. El mejor resumen con las mejores jugadas, goles e imágenes de cada uno de los partidos de la competición copera.

programme.title: Euroliga de baloncesto: Real Madrid - Fenerbahce
programme.desc: El Real Madrid (5-3) busca su sexta victoria consecutiva frente al poderoso Fenerbahce (6-2) en el Movistar Arena, donde lleva 18 victorias consecutivas. Los Blancos vienen de ganar en Vitoria anotando más de 100 puntos por tercer partido consecutivo. El equipo de Jasikevicius perdió el martes en el Roig Arena 86-78. Duelo de estilos entre el segundo mejor ataque de la competición, el Real Madrid, y la mejor defensa, la de Fenerbahce.

programme.title: Chava. El ciclista del pueblo
programme.desc: Desde Ávila llegó al corazón de todos los aficionados al ciclismo. Firmó diez años de logros, conquistó 28 victorias y llegó a convertirse en uno de los clásicos en la Vuelta llegando al subir al pódium en 1998. Hace más de 20 años despedimos a José María Jiménez "El Chava".

programme.title: Informe Plus+. Eternas
programme.desc: La selección española femenina de waterpolo nunca se había clasificado para los Juegos Olímpicos y nunca se había subido al podio en los Campeonatos del mundo. Con la llegada de Miki Oca como seleccionador arrancó un ciclo ganador que las ha llevado a conquistar, en los últimos 12 años, un botín de 13 medallas. La que más brilla, sin duda, la del reciente oro en los Juegos de París.

La armada española estará compuesta por Real Madrid, Barça, Valencia y Baskonia, que aspiran a reeditar el éxito de la pasada temporada de Blancos y Taronjas que llegaron a disputar la Final 4. Este curso los enemigos a batir serán los dos equipos griegos, Olympiakos y Panathinaikos. Los Rojos, actuales campeones, vuelve a ser los grandes favoritos. Los Verdes se han reforzado mucho este verano para tratar de volver a ser campeones de Europa. programme.title: Hermanos y Enemigos
programme.desc: Vlade Divac y Drazen Petrovic son dos de los mejores jugadores europeos de baloncesto de todos los tiempos y brillaron en la NBA, abriendo el camino a otros como Gasol o Nowitzki. Divac, de origen serbio y Petrovic, croata, que fueron amigos cuando jugaban juntos en la selección de Yugoslavia, dejaron de hablarse cuando se vieron en bandos distintos durante la guerra civil que asoló su país. Nunca hubo oportunidad de que se reconciliaran porque Petrovic murió en un trágico accidente de tráfico en 1993.

programme.title: Informe Plus. Atypical Spanish
programme.desc: El patinaje sobre hielo español vive una etapa de transformación, frescura y vanguardia. La británica Olivia Smart y el alemán Tim Dieck conforman una alianza tan singular como brillante que compite con orgullo y entusiasmo representando a España. Herederos y continuadores del camino trazado por el gran referente de nuestro patinaje, Javier Fernández, este tándem ha conquistado a jueces, público y rivales con su estilo renovador.

programme.title: Informe Plus+. Andrea Fuentes, locura artística
programme.desc: Andrea Fuentes ha sido uno de los nombres del deporte español en 2025. Pero su historia va mucho más allá, desde sus años de nadadora a las órdenes de Anna Tarrés a su medalla de plata con Estados Unidos, digna de un guion de Hollywood. Con una personalidad y un método únicos, la actual seleccionadora de natación artística plantea una visión del deporte de élite rompedora y llena de carisma, mientras en lo personal rebosa humanidad y emoción.

programme.title: Beckhamanía
programme.desc: A finales de los años 90, Beckham transformó la tradicional imagen del futbolista con su estilo único y atrevido y su matrimonio con la Spice Girl Victoria Adams. Una unión que terminó de catapultarle como una marca global cuyo legado continúa hoy. `Beckhamanía" revive el fenómeno deportivo, comercial y sociológico que explotó en Reino Unido para impactar después en todo el mundo. Especialmente en España, tras el fichaje del inglés por el Real Madrid en 2003.

programme.title: Informe Plus. Toni Bou, 40 de 40
programme.desc: Toni Bou lleva casi dos décadas haciendo posible lo imposible. Desde 2007, el piloto de trial ha construido una trayectoria sin precedentes hasta alcanzar una cifra extraordinaria: 40 títulos mundiales. Pero detrás de los récords, las victorias y una superioridad que parece no tener fin, hay una historia de sacrificio, dolor, evolución y una ambición intacta.Este Informe Plus muestra desde dentro la conquista de su Mundial número 40, un hito con el que Toni Bou ha vuelto a hacer historia y se consagra como uno de los deportistas más laureados de todos los tiempos.

programme.desc: El 11 de julio de 2010 quedará para siempre como una de las fechas más importantes del fútbol español. Ese día, la selección española consiguió su ansiada primera Copa del Mundo. Este documental narra el camino hacia la victoria de la Roja en el Mundial de Sudáfrica 2010.

programme.title: Rexach. Correr es de cobardes

programme.title: Informe Plus. Toni Bou, 40 de 40
programme.desc: Toni Bou lleva casi dos décadas haciendo posible lo imposible. Desde 2007, el piloto de trial ha construido una trayectoria sin precedentes hasta alcanzar una cifra extraordinaria: 40 títulos mundiales. Pero detrás de los récords, las victorias y una superioridad que parece no tener fin, hay una historia de sacrificio, dolor, evolución y una ambición intacta.Este Informe Plus muestra desde dentro la conquista de su Mundial número 40, un hito con el que Toni Bou ha vuelto a hacer historia y se consagra como uno de los deportistas más laureados de todos los tiempos.

programme.title: Lamine Yamal. Revolución 304

programme.title: Euroliga de baloncesto: Real Madrid - Fenerbahce
programme.desc: El Real Madrid (5-3) busca su sexta victoria consecutiva frente al poderoso Fenerbahce (6-2) en el Movistar Arena, donde lleva 18 victorias consecutivas. Los Blancos vienen de ganar en Vitoria anotando más de 100 puntos por tercer partido consecutivo. El equipo de Jasikevicius perdió el martes en el Roig Arena 86-78. programme.desc: تدور أحداث المسلسل حول ملك التي تحاول بناء حياة جديدة مع عائلتها، كما تجاهد من أجل البقاء مع أطفالها الثلاثة. Gaziantep-born Melek is married and has three kids. Her life is turned upside down when her spouse leaves her alone and takes the kids with him.

A drama that covers four stories (the Seventh Month, My Autistic Child, Honeymoon, and Obsession), all of which are connected by the theme of infidelity and revenge.(n)

programme.title: لولا الحب
programme.desc: تدور أحداث المسلسل حول الفتاة مسا (نادين الراسي) التي تعمل وسط مجال إعلامي كبير وتستغل تلك الوظيفة في تسليط الضوء على مجموعة من القضايا والمشاكل الهامة في المجتمع متحدية العديد من الشخصيات ذو السلطة والنفوذ.. في ذات الوقت تحاول اتخاذ قرار بشأن علاقتها غير الشرعية وحملها. The series revolves around Missa, who works in a large media field and sheds light on a range of important issues and problems in society in defiance of many figures with power and influence, while she tries to decide on her affair and pregnancy.

programme.title: علاقات خاصة
programme.desc: يجسد كل زوجين قصة درامية تتشابك أحداثها بشكل أو بأخر مع العلاقات الأخرى بدءًا من «جو» رجل الأعمال المتزوج من «ياسمين» التي تنتمي لبيئة فقيرة ليصنع منها نجمة غناء، وترتبط حياة «جو وياسمين» بـ «حسام» المتزوج من «فرح»، بالرغم من رفض أهلها لهذا الزواج بسبب فارق السن، أما «جهاد» فيقع ضحية إنتقام مزدوج من أخته «رنا» و«إياد» حبيب زوجته المستقبلية «لامار»، أمّا «تيم» فيحب «مايا» رغم اختلاف الديانة. The events of each couple's story are intertwined with other relationships, starting with Jo, a businessman married to Yasmin, who becomes a singing star. Hossam who is married to Farah. While Jehad is the victim of double revenge from his sister Rana and Eiad. As for Tayem, he's in love with Maya despite having a different religion.

programme.title: دورة جونية جبيل
programme.desc: تدور الأحداث في إطار كوميدي متصل منفصل حول سائق أتوبيس يعمل على خط “دورة -جونية-جبيل” والذي يتعرض بسبب ظروف عمله لأحداث كثيرة، منها كوميدية ومنها رومانسية. In a series of separate episodes, a bus driver on the Daoura-Jounieh-Byblos line is exposed to many events, including comedic and romantic ones.

programme.title: بيروت 303
programme.desc: تتفجر طائرة بيروت 303 فوق شاطئ لبنان، فتحول حياة القلة من الناجين إلى رحلة بحث عن الحقيقة، ضمن إطار غامض ومليء بالشك. The Beirut 303 plane explodes over the coast of Lebanon, turning the life of the few survivors into a truth-searching journey.

programme.title: نهاركم سعيد
programme.desc: برنامج صباحي يومي، يهتم بمناقشة آخر المستجدات على الساحة السياسية، من خلال إستضافة المحليين السياسيين، لمناقشة القضايا التي تهم الرأي العام في لبنان. كان البرنامج عند انطلاقته بعام 1996 يتناول الأحداث السياسية بفقرة صغيرة مدتها نصف ساعة وبقية فترة البرنامج كانت حول أمور ثقافية ومنوعة. A regular morning program that hosts local politicians to talk about subjects that are important to the people in Lebanon and to debate the latest events in the political scene. When it was launched in 1996, the program dealt with political events in a small segment lasting half an hour, and the rest of the program period was about cultural and other matters.

programme.title: حدوتة حب
programme.desc: في إطار درامي تدور الأحداث حول أربع قصص (الشهر السابع، طفلي المتوحد، شهر عسل، الهاجس) يجمع بينهما دافع الانتقام والخيانة. programme.title: آسر
programme.desc: بعد خيانة أصدقائه والمرأة التي أحبها، يجد (مجد) نفسه خلف القضبان. لكنه لا ينهزم بملامح جديدة وهوية مختلفة، يعود (آسر) لهدف واحد: الانتقام، وذلك في إطار من الدراما والتشويق. After getting betrayed by his friends and the woman he loved, Majd finds himself behind bars but not defeated. With a new face and a different identity, Aser returns with one goal in mind: vengeance.

programme.title: ثواني
programme.desc: تدور أحداث المسلسل حول ممرضة وزوجها يعيشان حياة عادية، ولديهم علاقات جيدة بالناس المحيطة بهم، لكن حياتهما تتغير بسبب حادث يقع لهما يقلب حياتهما رأسًا على عقب، فيدخلان في صراع مع الشخصيات التي تحيط بحياتهما وسط صراع متشابك يسعيان فيه لمواجهة الأطراف الأخرى. The story of a nurse living peacefully with her husband in a neighborhood where they are liked and accepted by everyone. However, their lives are turned upside down when they get involved in an accident, leading to problems with everyone around them.

programme.title: بيروت 303
programme.desc: تتفجر طائرة بيروت 303 فوق شاطئ لبنان، فتحول حياة القلة من الناجين إلى رحلة بحث عن الحقيقة، ضمن إطار غامض ومليء بالشك. The Beirut 303 plane explodes over the coast of Lebanon, turning the life of the few survivors into a truth-searching journey.

programme.title: أولاد الراعي
programme.desc: من نقطة الصفر وجذور بسيطة، ينطلق ثلاثة أشقاء في رحلة كفاح مريرة لبناء إمبراطورية تجارية تهز عالم المال. ومع تضخم الثروة والنفوذ، يتحول النجاح إلى اختبار قاسٍ لروابط الدم؛ حيث تتشابك المصالح وتنفجر صراعات السلطة والولاء بينهم. يضعهم العمل أمام خيارات مصيرية تهدد الكيان الذي بنوه معاً، كاشفاً كيف يمكن للمال أن يغير القلوب ويقلب الأشقاء إلى خصوم في ساحة معركة لا ترحم. From scratch, three brothers embark on a bitter struggle to build a business empire. As wealth grows, success turns into a severe test of blood ties, where interests intertwine and power and loyalty struggles clash between them. The brothers are faced with fateful choices that threaten the entity they built together, revealing how money can turn siblings into opponents on a merciless battlefield.(n)

programme.title: The Best Thing
programme.desc: تدور الأحداث حول (شين شيفان)، مديرة فندق مهووسة بالعمل، تلتقي بالطبيب الهادئ (خه سو يه) أثناء بحثها عن علاج. ورغم أن علاقتهما تبدأ طبيعية، فإن الصدفة تجمعهما كجيران، فتتطور بينهما مشاعر حب. The events revolve around Shen Xifan, a workaholic hotel manager, who meets the quiet doctor He Su Ye while searching for a cure. Although their relationship begins professionally, coincidence brings them together as neighbors, and feelings of love develop between them.(n)

programme.title: Barbaros: Sword of the Mediterranean
programme.desc: يحكي المسلسل قصة حياة البحار خير الدين بربروس، الذي صنع بطولات لا تنسى للإمبراطورية العثمانية في عهد السلطان سليم الأول، والذي ضمن السيادة العثمانية في البحر الأبيض المتوسط، وكان من أكبر مؤيدي خير الدين بربروس شقيقه عروج بربروس الذي تمكن من السيطرة على جميع السواحل. The story of the life of the sailor Hayreddin Pasha "Barbarossa" and his unforgettable heroics for the Ottoman Empire during the reign of Sultan Selim I, which guaranteed Ottoman sovereignty in the Mediterranean. One of Barbarossa's biggest supporters was his brother Oruc, who managed to control all the coasts.

programme.title: أولاد الراعي
programme.desc: من نقطة الصفر وجذور بسيطة، ينطلق ثلاثة أشقاء في رحلة كفاح مريرة لبناء إمبراطورية تجارية تهز عالم المال. ومع تضخم الثروة والنفوذ، يتحول النجاح إلى اختبار قاسٍ لروابط الدم؛ حيث تتشابك المصالح وتنفجر صراعات السلطة والولاء بينهم. يضعهم العمل أمام خيارات مصيرية تهدد الكيان الذي بنوه معاً، كاشفاً كيف يمكن للمال أن يغير القلوب ويقلب الأشقاء إلى خصوم في ساحة معركة لا ترحم. From scratch, three brothers embark on a bitter struggle to build a business empire. As wealth grows, success turns into a severe test of blood ties, where interests intertwine and power and loyalty struggles clash between them. The brothers are faced with fateful choices that threaten the entity they built together, revealing how money can turn siblings into opponents on a merciless battlefield.

programme.title: The Best Thing
programme.desc: تدور الأحداث حول (شين شيفان)، مديرة فندق مهووسة بالعمل، تلتقي بالطبيب الهادئ (خه سو يه) أثناء بحثها عن علاج. ورغم أن علاقتهما تبدأ طبيعية، فإن الصدفة تجمعهما كجيران، فتتطور بينهما مشاعر حب. The events revolve around Shen Xifan, a workaholic hotel manager, who meets the quiet doctor He Su Ye while searching for a cure. Although their relationship begins professionally, coincidence brings them together as neighbors, and feelings of love develop between them.

programme.title: بخمس أرواح
programme.desc: بين ليلة وضحاها، يجد "شمس" الملقب بـ "ابن الميتة" نفسه أمام مفارقة قدرية؛ فهو الوريث الوحيد لرجل نافذ، لكن الثروة معلقة بشرط تعجيزي: العثور على أشقائه الأربعة الذين طمس والدهم أثرهم من الوجود. في سباقٍ محموم مع الزمن، يخوض شمس رحلةً محفوفة بالدماء لكشف الهوية، حيث الفشل لا يعني ضياع المال فحسب، بل خسارة حياته أمام طامعين ينتظرون سقوطه. Shams, nicknamed “the dead woman's son,” finds himself the only heir to an influential man, but the fortune is subject to an impossible condition: finding his four siblings, whose existence his father wiped out of records. In a frantic race against time, Shams embarks on a blood-filled journey to uncover his identity, as failure does not only mean losing the money, but also losing his life.

programme.title: رسوم متحركة
programme.desc: السنافر شخصيات خيالية صغيرة الحجم، زرقاء اللون، وتعيش في الغابة، تمثل عائلة السنافر الكثير من الشخصيات مختلفة الطباع، والسنافر كثر. للسنافر عدو كريه هو شرشبيل الشرير وقطه الأحمر المشاكس "هرهور" اللذان يعيشان في القلعة المهجورة. The Smurfs are small, blue-colored creatures living in mushroom houses in an enchanted forest. Their peaceful life is constantly interrupted by the evil wizard Gargamel and his nasty cat Azrael who live in an abandoned castle.

programme.title: خبز وملح
programme.desc: يعالج المسلسل مشكلة السمنة التي باتت ظاهرة سلبية تشغل المجتمعات العربية والقائمين على وسائل الإعلام فيها و يهتم بالصحة العامة ويقدم النصيحة الطبية والمعلومة الصحية للمشاهدين، من خلال عائلة تعاني من مشاكل صحية مختلفة بسبب عاداتهم الغذائية السيئة.

A youth program broadcast on Roya TV that shows all the news that concerns young people on social networking sites, such as fashion, cooking, and life concerns, and strange polls are also conducted.

programme.title: النويلاتي
programme.desc: في حارة النوياتي التي تغلي بصراعات السلطة والمال، تنطلق حكاية يمتزج فيها الواقع بالأساطير. يعود الغواص من وراء قضبان سجن وُصف بالمقبرة، عائدا بهوية غامضة ووجه غريب ليخترق الحارة من جديد. لا يسعى الغواص للانتقام من الذين خانوه فحسب، بل يقتفي أثر "كنز مفقود" يُقال إنه محروس بطلسم قديم. وفي ظل هذه الظروف القاسية تتقاطع الدروب مع مكائد تجار الدماء، حيث تصبح الهوية المزيفة هي الدرع الوحيد بمعركة البقاء. In the Al Nwaylati neighborhood unfolds a tale where reality and myth intertwine. Ghawwas comes out of prison, seeking not only revenge against those who betrayed him but also pursues a lost treasure. Amidst these harsh circumstances, his path crosses with the machinations of ruthless profiteers, making his assumed identity his only shield in the battle for survival.

programme.desc: تدور الأحداث في أروقة «السوق الحرة» بأحد المطارات الدولية، حيث تتقاطع طرق المسافرين العابرين مع الموظفين، فتحدث بينهم مواقف طريفة ومفارقات كوميدية تعكس تباين الثقافات والشخصيات، وتبدّد رتابة أجواء العمل اليومية. Taking place in an international airport's duty-free zone, where the paths of passing travelers intersect with the staff, leading to funny situations and comic mishaps to unfold between them that reflect the contrast of cultures and personalities, and dissipate the monotony of the daily work atmosphere.

programme.desc: برنامج أسبوعي منوع، تلتقي فيه منى الشاذلي بالناس بعيدًا عن زحام الأحداث اليومية وتوتر الأخبار المتلاحقة، لتنقل لهم حكايات حقيقية لم يشاهدوها أو يسمعوها من قبل الأبطال وشخصيات تستحق اﻹحترام. A weekly diverse talk show, where Mona Al Shazly meets with people away from the tension of daily news and events, to present her audience with original and genuine stories they have never heard of before, about people and heroes who deserve respect and admiration.(n)

programme.title: بيت مراد
programme.desc: برنامج يقدمه الكاتب والسيناريست أحمد مراد برفقة ابنته، يتناول فيه عددًا من أشهر الكتب والروايات، في حوارات خفيفة وشيّقة يوضح من خلالها أهمية القراءة ودورها في تشكيل الوعي والثقافة، وكيف كان لبعض المؤلفات المصرية تأثير واسع وصل إلى قراء حول العالم. ويستضيف البرنامج في مواسمه المختلفة عددًا من نجوم الفن. The show is hosted by writer and author Ahmed Mourad alongside his daughter. Together, they discuss a selection of famous books and novels in light and engaging conversations, highlighting the importance of reading, its role in shaping culture and awareness, and how Egyptian literature has reached readers around the world. The show also features guest appearances by renowned artists.(n)

programme.title: الكبير أوي ج8
programme.desc: في هذا الجزء من المسلسل، يتعرض (الكبير أوي) عمدة قرية (المزاريطة) لضغوط عديدة، حيث يجد نفسه مضطرًا للاهتمام بقضايا ومشاكل من حوله، ويتعرض لمواقف كوميدية. Al-Kabir, the mayor of the village of Mazarita, is exposed to many pressures. He finds himself forced to pay attention to the issues and problems of those around him, and he is exposed to comical situations.

programme.title: بيت مراد

programme.title: العائدون
programme.desc: تدور الأحداث حول محاولات المخابرات المصرية التصدي للإرهاب متمثلًا في داعش، حيث يقوم العاملون بالمخابرات من ضباط وخبراء اتصال وعملاء سريين كلٌ بدوره في عمليات تهدف إلى حماية الوطن والقضاء على الإرهاب. The events revolve around the attempts of the Egyptian intelligence to confront terrorism represented by ISIS, as the intelligence workers, including officers, communication experts, and secret agents, perform their roles in operations aimed at protecting the homeland and eliminating terrorism.(n)

programme.title: بدون سابق إنذار
programme.desc: تتدهور العلاقة بين الزوجين (مروان) و(ليلى) وتصل إلى نفق مسدود بالرغم من محاولتهما لإصلاحها، ولكن تأخذ الأمور منعطفًا صادمًا حينما يكتشفا إصابة ابنهما بسرطان الدم، وتتوالى الأحداث. The relationship between the married couple Marwan and Laila deteriorates and reaches a dead end despite their attempts to fix it. However, things take a shocking turn when they discover that their son has leukemia.(n)

programme.title: قسمة العدل
programme.desc: في إطار درامي تشويقي، يتناول العمل صراع ثلاثة أشقاء على أملاك وثروة والدهم الحي، بينما تقف أختهم الوحيدة بين أطماعهم المتصاعدة، لتظل النهاية معلقة بسؤال: من ينتصر في هذا الصراع العائلي. programme.desc: تتدهور العلاقة بين الزوجين (مروان) و(ليلى) وتصل إلى نفق مسدود بالرغم من محاولتهما لإصلاحها، ولكن تأخذ الأمور منعطفًا صادمًا حينما يكتشفا إصابة ابنهما بسرطان الدم، وتتوالى الأحداث. The relationship between the married couple Marwan and Laila deteriorates and reaches a dead end despite their attempts to fix it. However, things take a shocking turn when they discover that their son has leukemia.

programme.title: قسمة العدل
programme.desc: في إطار درامي تشويقي، يتناول العمل صراع ثلاثة أشقاء على أملاك وثروة والدهم الحي، بينما تقف أختهم الوحيدة بين أطماعهم المتصاعدة، لتظل النهاية معلقة بسؤال: من ينتصر في هذا الصراع العائلي. It follows the struggle of three brothers over the property and wealth of their living father, while their only sister stands between their rising ambitions, leaving the ending hanging by the question: Who wins in this family conflict.

programme.title: صاحبة السعادة
programme.desc: برنامج منوعات يهدف للحفاظ على الهوية المصرية وإحيائها وسط المتغيرات السياسية والاجتماعية، وذلك من خلال استضافة نوعيات مختلفة من الضيوف كالنجوم وصناع الفن بكل فروعه، وكذلك نجوم الرياضة المصرية وصناع الموسيقى الذين يقدمون مشاريعهم الموسيقية المتميزة والمتفردة عبر البرنامج. A variety show that hosts a range of guests, including stars, artists, prominent Egyptian athletes, and musicians who showcase their distinctive and original musical projects to preserve and revitalize the Egyptian identity in the face of political and social change.

programme.title: الستات ميعرفوش يكدبوا
programme.desc: برنامج نسائي يومي يتضمن العديد من الفقرات التي تهم المرأة من طبخ ومكياج وموضة بالإضافة إلى فقرات أخرى خاصة بالسياسة والاقتصاد وكل القضايا الاجتماعية ولكن بعيون النساء، وأيضًا يستضيف العديد من الضيوف الذين يتم محاورتهم حول كل ما يهم الأسرة والمرأة بشكل خاص. Geared towards women, this daily program consists of a variety of segments related to cooking, beauty and fashion as well as other featured segments on politics, economics and social issues, explored from the perspective of women. The program also hosts a variety of guests who discuss a full range of topics, especially issues concerning women and their families.(n)

programme.title: ستهم
programme.desc: بعدما يُقتل زوجها، تدخل (ستهم) في عدة صراعات مع أسرتها وتحاول تربية أبناءها بعيدا عن المشاكل، ثم تضطر للتنكر في هيئة رجل حتى تواجه الصعوبات التي تقابلها في الحياة. After her husband is killed, Settohom gets into several conflicts with her family and tries to raise her children away from problems; however, she is forced to disguise herself as a man to face the difficulties she encounters in life.(n)

programme.title: أولاد الراعي
programme.desc: من نقطة الصفر وجذور بسيطة، ينطلق ثلاثة أشقاء في رحلة كفاح مريرة لبناء إمبراطورية تجارية تهز عالم المال. ومع تضخم الثروة والنفوذ، يتحول النجاح إلى اختبار قاسٍ لروابط الدم؛ حيث تتشابك المصالح وتنفجر صراعات السلطة والولاء بينهم. يضعهم العمل أمام خيارات مصيرية تهدد الكيان الذي بنوه معاً، كاشفاً كيف يمكن للمال أن يغير القلوب ويقلب الأشقاء إلى خصوم في ساحة معركة لا ترحم. From scratch, three brothers embark on a bitter struggle to build a business empire. As wealth grows, success turns into a severe test of blood ties, where interests intertwine and power and loyalty struggles clash between them. The brothers are faced with fateful choices that threaten the entity they built together, revealing how money can turn siblings into opponents on a merciless battlefield.(n)

programme.title: أزمة ثقة
programme.desc: تحدث جريمة قتل تقلب حياة الجميع رأسًا على عقب وتضعهم في مواجهة مع ماضي عائلي مليء بالصراعات، حيث تتسبب الأموال في خلافات ما بين الشقيقات الثلاث في ظل انتشار الشك وانعدام الثقة بينهم. A murder turns everyone's lives upside down and brings them face-to-face with a family's conflict-ridden past, as money causes discord among the three sisters amidst widespread suspicion and mistrust.(n)

As wealth grows, success turns into a severe test of blood ties, where interests intertwine and power and loyalty struggles clash between them. The brothers are faced with fateful choices that threaten the entity they built together, revealing how money can turn siblings into opponents on a merciless battlefield.

programme.title: أزمة ثقة
programme.desc: تحدث جريمة قتل تقلب حياة الجميع رأسًا على عقب وتضعهم في مواجهة مع ماضي عائلي مليء بالصراعات، حيث تتسبب الأموال في خلافات ما بين الشقيقات الثلاث في ظل انتشار الشك وانعدام الثقة بينهم. A murder turns everyone's lives upside down and brings them face-to-face with a family's conflict-ridden past, as money causes discord among the three sisters amidst widespread suspicion and mistrust.

programme.title: أمين وشركاه
programme.desc: سلسلة من العروض المسرحية الكوميدية التي يقوم ببطولتها النجم الكوميدي أحمد أمين على خشبة مسرح جامعة مصر للعلوم والتكنولوجيا، وفي كل مرة عرض كوميدي مختلف. A series of comedic theatrical performances by Ahmed Amin. Each episode is a different comedy show with different themes.

programme.title: السقوط في بئر سبع
programme.desc: يدور المسلسل حول قصة حقيقية من ملفات المخابرات المصرية، حول تجنيد مصري وزوجته للتجسس لصالح إسرائيل، القصة نقلًا عن رواية (إبراهيم وانشراح) للكاتب الصحفي عبدالرحمن فهمي. Based on the novel "Ibrahim and Inshirah" by journalist Abdel Rahman Fahmy, the series revolves around a true story from the Egyptian intelligence files, about the recruitment of an Egyptian man and his wife to spy for the benefit of Israel.(n)

programme.title: روج أسود
programme.desc: يتناول مجموعة قصص درامية مستوحاة من الواقع تتعلق بـ نساء يواجهن مشاكل حقيقية في حياتهن الزوجية والعائلية، وتتقاطع الأحداث داخل محكمة الأسرة المصرية، حيث تُعرض قضايا متنوعة تتجاوز الخيانة والانفصال إلى تعقيدات اجتماعية أكثر عمقًا. It follows a number of stories inspired by true events related to women facing real problems in their marital and family lives, and the events intersect within the Egyptian Family Court, where various cases are presented that go beyond betrayal and separation to deeper social complexities.(n)

programme.title: آخر النهار
programme.desc: برنامج حواري يرصد أهم القضايا المصرية وأحدث الأخبار، بخلاف نجاحه في كشف كثيرٍ من القضايا السياسية والاجتماعية والاقتصادية التي تهم المواطن. يقدمه كوكبة من الإعلاميين بينهم (محمود سعد، وعادل حمودة وخالد صلاح) بشكلٍ شبه يومي، يستضيف مجموعة من خبراء الاقتصاد والسياسة وعلم الاجتماع ولا يضر ذكر أطباء الطب النفسي وعلماء الدين من أجل تثقيف المواطن وفهم مجريات الأمور ،ومحاولة فضح المسكوت عنه وكشف أسباب وحلول تلك القضايا. A talk show about current events and Egyptian politics, society, and economy with media specialists like Mahmoud Saad, Adel Hamoda, and Khaled Salah as hosts. programme.title: رسالة الإمام
programme.desc: يحكي المسلسل في إطار تاريخي الأحداث الحقيقية لحياة الإمام محمد الشافعي، والصعوبات التي واجهته أثناء محاولته في نشر رسالته. The series tells the real events of the life of Imam Muhammad al-Shafi'i, and the difficulties he faced while trying to spread his message.(n)

programme.title: حرب
programme.desc: تدور أحداث المسلسل حول عضو في أحد الجماعات الإرهابية المتطرفة يدعى (الظافر)، ويحاول تنفيذ عدد من العمليات الإرهابية في مصر، لكنه يتعرض للملاحقة من قبل الأجهزة الأمنية. The events revolve around a member of an extremist terrorist group called Al Zafer, who is trying to carry out a number of terrorist operations in Egypt, but he gets pursued by the security services.(n)

programme.title: حكايات بنات ج5
programme.desc: يستكمل الجزء الخامس من مسلسل (حكايات بنات) متابعة رحلة 4 سيدات (نور، جميلة، جايدا، عائشة) وحياتهن العاطفية، من البدايات الجديدة إلى الفراق والنهايات المأساوية. The journey of the four girls -Nour, Jamila, Jayda, Aisha- continues and their love life, from new beginnings to separation and tragic ends.(n)

programme.title: ﺑﺮﻧﺎﻣﺞ توك شو
programme.desc: أحد أهم البرامج الحوارية بدأ إذاعته عام 2006 مع معتز الدمرداش وريهام السهلي، ولكن في عام 2011 انضم الإعلامي عمرو الليثي للبرنامج بعد أن انسحب الدمرداش من تقديمه. يهتم البرنامج بالأخبار المهمة والأحداث اليومية التي تدور في الشارع المصري والعربى، كما يرصد أيضاً اهتمامات المشاهدين وآراءهم وتطلعاتهم، كما يستقبل العديد من الضيوف من رجال السياسة والإعلام والاقتصاد. In 2006, Riham El Sahly and Moataz Al Demerdash hosted one of the most significant talk shows. In 2011, journalist Amr Al Laithy replaced Al Demerdash on the show. The show highlights Arab and Egyptian neighborhood events. Additionally, it tracks viewer objectives, views, and interests. Economists, journalists, and politicians are also regular guests.

programme.title: ﺑﺮﻧﺎﻣﺞ توك شو
programme.desc: أحد أهم البرامج الحوارية بدأ إذاعته عام 2006 مع معتز الدمرداش وريهام السهلي، ولكن في عام 2011 انضم الإعلامي عمرو الليثي للبرنامج بعد أن انسحب الدمرداش من تقديمه. يهتم البرنامج بالأخبار المهمة والأحداث اليومية التي تدور في الشارع المصري والعربى، كما يرصد أيضاً اهتمامات المشاهدين وآراءهم وتطلعاتهم، كما يستقبل العديد من الضيوف من رجال السياسة والإعلام والاقتصاد. programme.title: قلع الحجر
programme.desc: في إطار درامي، تدور أحداث المسلسل في الصعيد، حول قصة حدثت بالفعل، حيث العمدة (فرماوي)، والشاب المتمرد (عبدالحي) الذي يدخل في عدة أزمات بسبب تسلط والديه، كما يتطرق العمل إلى قضية حقوق المرأة. The series is set in Upper Egypt and is based on a true event in which the tyrannical parents of Abdul Hayy, a rebellious young man, force him to face several difficulties. The work also addresses the issue of women’s rights.(n)

programme.title: بـ١٠٠ راجل
programme.desc: في إطار درامي اجتماعي، تدور الأحداث حول (غالية أبو الدهب) التي تواجه العديد من المتاعب، وبعد مقتل زوجها (عادل) خلال حفل زفافهما، تضطر (غالية) للعمل سائقة ميكروباص؛ وتواجه العديد من الصدمات أهمها دخولها السجن. The events revolve around Ghalia Abu Al Dahab, who faces challenges and troubles in her life. She is a woman from a poor area who was forced by circumstances to work as a microbus driver after the death of her husband.(n)

programme.title: ريا وسكينة
programme.desc: قصة حياة الأختين (ريا) و(سكينة)، وهما من أشهر مجرمات القرن العشرين في مصر. روعتا النساء في مطلع القرن وكانتا وراء مقتل العشرات، ويعرض المسلسل الظروف التي أدت إلى تحول الأختين ريا وسكينة إلى مجرمتين مستعرضًا تطورات حياتهما وصلتهما بالمحيطين بهما، وتأثير البيئة التي نشأت فيها الأختان على مستقبلهما. The story of the lives of sisters Rayya and Sakina, two of the most famous criminals of the 20th century in Egypt as they terrified women and masterminded dozens of deaths. The series presents the circumstances that led them to becoming criminals and the impact of the environment on their future.

programme.title: صباح البلد
programme.desc: برنامج (صباح البلد) برنامج شامل في موضوعاته ويعرض على قناة (صدى البلد)، تقدمه الإعلامية (دينا رامز). A comprehensive program that airs on the Sada El Balad channel, presented by the journalist Dina Ramez.

programme.title: ظل
programme.desc: خيوط عدة تتشابك، حيث يترك قيس عمله في المحاماه لعدم تحمله السكوت عن الظلم، في الوقت ذاته يستغل جلال القانون من أجل مصالحه الشخصية، وعلى الجهة الأخرى يحاول جبران مصمم الأزياء العالمي تجاوز أزمته بعد انتحار حبيبته نواره. Qais leaves his legal profession because he cannot bear to remain silent about injustice, while Jalal uses the law for his own personal interests. On the other hand, Gibran, the international fashion designer, is trying to overcome the suicide of his girlfriend, Nawara.(n)

programme.title: بيت الشدة
programme.desc: حفيدة مشعوذ وساحر تُدعى (فَلك) تعود إلى منزل جدها، لأجل الانتقام مِن مَن حرقوا المنزل قديمًا، في ظل وجود لعنة تطارد ابنها سيف وهي سيطرة روح الجد على جسده، فتجد نفسها في مواجهة تصدي أهل الحارة لها بقيادة (مختار) وسرعان ما تتطور الأمور. The granddaughter of a sorcerer and magician named Falak returns to her grandfather's house, in order to take revenge on those who burned the house in the past. However, there is a curse chasing her son Seif, where his grandfather's spirit controls his body.(n)

programme.title: فن الحرب
programme.desc: يختار زياد طريق التمثيل بدلًا من الانضمام إلى أعمال والده، لكن خيانة مفاجئة تؤدي إلى انهيار إمبراطورية العائلة ودخول والده السجن. وبعد وفاة والده، يعود زياد مصممًا على استرداد الأموال المسروقة واستعادة اسم العائلة، مستعينًا بموهبته في التمثيل وحيله الذكية للانتقام ممن دمّروا حياتهم. ومع اقترابه من هدفه، يجد نفسه عالقًا في لعبة مزدوجة خطيرة، خاصة حين تقع دينا، ابنة عدوه، في حبه وتساعده سرًا. Ziad chooses acting instead of joining his father’s business, but a sudden betrayal leads to the collapse of the family empire. After his father’s death, Ziad returns determined to recover the stolen money and restore the family name, using his acting skills and clever schemes against those who ruined their lives. But as he gets close to his goal, he becomes trapped in a dangerous double game.(n)

programme.title: تاجر السعادة

programme.title: فن الحرب
programme.desc: يختار زياد طريق التمثيل بدلًا من الانضمام إلى أعمال والده، لكن خيانة مفاجئة تؤدي إلى انهيار إمبراطورية العائلة ودخول والده السجن. وبعد وفاة والده، يعود زياد مصممًا على استرداد الأموال المسروقة واستعادة اسم العائلة، مستعينًا بموهبته في التمثيل وحيله الذكية للانتقام ممن دمّروا حياتهم. ومع اقترابه من هدفه، يجد نفسه عالقًا في لعبة مزدوجة خطيرة، خاصة حين تقع دينا، ابنة عدوه، في حبه وتساعده سرًا. Ziad chooses acting instead of joining his father’s business, but a sudden betrayal leads to the collapse of the family empire. After his father’s death, Ziad returns determined to recover the stolen money and restore the family name, using his acting skills and clever schemes against those who ruined their lives. But as he gets close to his goal, he becomes trapped in a dangerous double game.

مسلسل (2007) (?)

programme.title: في بيتنا روبوت
programme.desc: يعمل شاب يُدعى يوسف على مشروع تصنيع إنسان آلي بذكاء اصطناعي، وحينما ينجح في تصنيع النموذجين زومبا ولذيذ، سرعان ما تنقلب حياته وحياة عائلته رأسا على عقب. A young man named Youssef works on a project to manufacture an artificial intelligence robot. But as he succeeds in manufacturing the two robots Zumba and Laziz, his life and his family's life quickly turns upside down.(n)

programme.title: ذئاب الجبل
programme.desc: في بلدة تسمى بهتون الجبل التي يعيش فيها عائلة هوارة التي تلتزم بالعديد من العادات والتقاليد المتعصبة، والتي قام فيها الشيخ بدار بكسر العادات المتعارف عليها وقام بتزويج ابنته إلى رجل غريب عن العائلة، مما يدفع شقيقها لأن يحاول قتلها. In a town called Bahtoon Al-Jabal where the Hawara family lives following many fanatic customs. Sheikh Badar breaks the customary traditions and marries his daughter to a man from outside of the family, prompting her brother to try to kill her.(n)

programme.title: مزاج الخير
programme.desc: تدور أحداث المسلسل في إطار الإثارة والتشويق، حول تاجر المخدرات أفندينا (مصطفى شعبان) الذي يحاول احتكار تجارة المخدرات، هذا مع وجود منافس قوي مثل المعلم (النوح) وابنه (براءة) اللذين يسعيان إلى الثأر لـ(غريب النوح) بعد أن قتله (أفندينا). The drug dealer, Afandina, tries to monopolize the drug trade in his neighborhood, but he has a tough rival in Al-Noah and his son Bara'a, who want to take revenge on Afandina for killing Gharib Al-Noah.(n)

programme.title: أبو العروسة ج2
programme.desc: استكمالا ﻷحداث الموسم الأول من المسلسل، تتطور الأحداث حيث تنتظر زينه (ولاء الشريف) - ابنه عبدالحميد (سيد رجب) - مولودتها الأولى، وتقرر هي وزوجها السفر لأمريكا لإنجاب طفلتها، ومن باب الصدفة يخبر الأطباء عبدالحميد أنه سيفقد بصره خلال شهر قبل أن يرى حفيدته الأولى. Continuing the events from the first season, Abdul Hamid's daughter Zeina is expecting her first child. She decides to travel to the US with her husband to give birth, and Abdul Hamid finds out that he will lose his sight.(n)

programme.title: السقوط في بئر سبع
programme.desc: يدور المسلسل حول قصة حقيقية من ملفات المخابرات المصرية، حول تجنيد مصري وزوجته للتجسس لصالح إسرائيل، القصة نقلًا عن رواية (إبراهيم وانشراح) للكاتب الصحفي عبدالرحمن فهمي. Based on the novel "Ibrahim and Inshirah" by journalist Abdel Rahman Fahmy, the series revolves around a true story from the Egyptian intelligence files, about the recruitment of an Egyptian man and his wife to spy for the benefit of Israel.(n)

programme.title: روج أسود
programme.desc: يتناول مجموعة قصص درامية مستوحاة من الواقع تتعلق بـ نساء يواجهن مشاكل حقيقية في حياتهن الزوجية والعائلية، وتتقاطع الأحداث داخل محكمة الأسرة المصرية، حيث تُعرض قضايا متنوعة تتجاوز الخيانة والانفصال إلى تعقيدات اجتماعية أكثر عمقًا. programme.title: كلبش 3
programme.desc: يتقدم (سليم الأنصاري) باستقالته من وزارة الداخلية إلى اللواء (جلال خطاب)، ولكن الأخير يعترض بشدة على هذا الطلب، وفي نهاية الأمر وبعد إلحاح يرضخ لطلب الاستقالة، ويتجه (سليم) بعد ذلك لتأسيس شركة أمن، ويشاركه (أكرم صفوان)، لكن فيما بعد تظهر بعض الخلافات بينهما، تتحول إلى عداوة وصراعات. programme.title: كلبش 3
programme.desc: يتقدم (سليم الأنصاري) باستقالته من وزارة الداخلية إلى اللواء (جلال خطاب)، ولكن الأخير يعترض بشدة على هذا الطلب، وفي نهاية الأمر وبعد إلحاح يرضخ لطلب الاستقالة، ويتجه (سليم) بعد ذلك لتأسيس شركة أمن، ويشاركه (أكرم صفوان)، لكن فيما بعد تظهر بعض الخلافات بينهما، تتحول إلى عداوة وصراعات. programme.desc: في بلدة تسمى بهتون الجبل التي يعيش فيها عائلة هوارة التي تلتزم بالعديد من العادات والتقاليد المتعصبة، والتي قام فيها الشيخ بدار بكسر العادات المتعارف عليها وقام بتزويج ابنته إلى رجل غريب عن العائلة، مما يدفع شقيقها لأن يحاول قتلها. In a town called Bahtoon Al-Jabal where the Hawara family lives following many fanatic customs. programme.title: قلع الحجر
programme.desc: في إطار درامي، تدور أحداث المسلسل في الصعيد، حول قصة حدثت بالفعل، حيث العمدة (فرماوي)، والشاب المتمرد (عبدالحي) الذي يدخل في عدة أزمات بسبب تسلط والديه، كما يتطرق العمل إلى قضية حقوق المرأة. The series is set in Upper Egypt and is based on a true event in which the tyrannical parents of Abdul Hayy, a rebellious young man, force him to face several difficulties. The work also addresses the issue of women’s rights.(n)

programme.title: بعد النهاية
programme.desc: تعود (جيهان) من أمريكا، وتفاجأ بخيانة زوجها (خالد) وصديقتها (داليا)، حيث تكتشف تلك الخيانة بنفسها بعد مكالمة من مجهول يدلها على مكانهما، وتتوالى الأحداث. Jehan returns from America, and is shocked to find her husband Khaled has been cheating on her with her friend Dalia. She discovers this betrayal herself after an anonymous call indicating their whereabouts, and events continue.(n)

programme.title: ريا وسكينة
programme.desc: قصة حياة الأختين (ريا) و(سكينة)، وهما من أشهر مجرمات القرن العشرين في مصر. روعتا النساء في مطلع القرن وكانتا وراء مقتل العشرات، ويعرض المسلسل الظروف التي أدت إلى تحول الأختين ريا وسكينة إلى مجرمتين مستعرضًا تطورات حياتهما وصلتهما بالمحيطين بهما، وتأثير البيئة التي نشأت فيها الأختان على مستقبلهما. The story of the lives of sisters Rayya and Sakina, two of the most famous criminals of the 20th century in Egypt as they terrified women and masterminded dozens of deaths. The series presents the circumstances that led them to becoming criminals and the impact of the environment on their future.(n)

programme.title: ليالي روكسي
programme.desc: تدور الأحداث حول كواليس صناعة أول فيلم سينمائي سوري في عام 1928، والصعوبات التي أحاطت به، كما يسلط الضوء على العديد من جوانب الحياة في تلك الفترة، خاصة مع وجود الاستعمار الفرنسي في سوريا. The events revolve around the making of the first Syrian motion picture in 1928, and the difficulties that surrounded it, shedding light on many aspects of life in that period, especially with the presence of French colonialism in Syria.(n)

programme.title: بـ١٠٠ راجل
programme.desc: في إطار درامي اجتماعي، تدور الأحداث حول (غالية أبو الدهب) التي تواجه العديد من المتاعب، وبعد مقتل زوجها (عادل) خلال حفل زفافهما، تضطر (غالية) للعمل سائقة ميكروباص؛ وتواجه العديد من الصدمات أهمها دخولها السجن. The events revolve around Ghalia Abu Al Dahab, who faces challenges and troubles in her life. She is a woman from a poor area who was forced by circumstances to work as a microbus driver after the death of her husband.(n)

programme.title: انحراف
programme.desc: المسلسل مأخوذ عن أحداث حقيقية، تدور فى دراما تشويقية مليئة بالغموض، حول انحراف عدد من الشخصيات عن الطبيعة البشرية؛ يصطدمون بطبيبة نفسية وتقرر تعديل المسار بطريقتها الخاصة. Based on a true story; the plot tackles the moral deviation of a number of characters who fall in the hands of a psychiatrist who decides to adjust their lives in her own way.(n)
